incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT: runtime-serving-high-5xx-rate fired (pd_incident: PDX-4789) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Trigger condition: service:runtime-serving, metric:5xx_rate > 0.5% over 1m (region:us-west)
ryan: Acked. I'm jumping in to look. Can someone pull grafana/p95 and recent deploys? :wave:
anya: looking. grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/runtime-overview?orgId=1&from=now-5m&to=now
anya: p95 is up ~1200ms for a 1m window, 5xx spikes to 0.8% for ~40s, then back down — looks transient and noisy
tim: Any customers impacted? Support ticket volume? :telephone_receiver:
miguel: support: nothing new in the last 10m, only 2 edge errors flagged (internal ticket #3456). No escalations.
priya: checking pods: `kubectl -n runtime get pods -l app=runtime | awk '{print $1,$3}'`
priya: tails show a couple of 502s from proxy -> runtime: ```
[2025-07-18T12:34:11Z] request_id=abc123 status=502 backend_conn_reset
[2025-07-18T12:34:13Z] request_id=def456 status=502 upstream_timeout
```
ryan: looks like a short proxy timeout cascade. Any deploys in the last 15m?
anya: no deploys in last 30m. Autoscaler churn? I see a couple of nodes rotated 12m ago due to preemptible reclaim.
miguel: PD auto-resolved (incident-bot says: PD incident PDX-4789 auto-resolved after no more firing) — then it fired again ~30s later and auto-resolved again. Flapping.
ryan: ok this is noisy. Mitigation: increase alert cooldown and add narrow suppress (only alert if >0.5% for 3m or 3 occurrences). I'll make a quick tweak then follow up with a postmortem follow-up if it recurs. :mechanical_arm:
priya: can we add a temporary routing fallback to older proxy version? We saw a couple of conn resets on proxy-5.0
tim: if it flaps again and we see customer tickets, escalate to eng-platform SRE pager.
anya: I pushed an alert change in `ops/alerts/runtime.yml` -> bump window to 3m and `for: 3m` (diff): ```diff
- alert: High5xxRate
- expr: increase(runtime_5xx_rate[1m]) > 0.005
- for: 1m
+ alert: High5xxRate
+ expr: increase(runtime_5xx_rate[3m]) > 0.005
+ for: 3m
```
miguel: PD notes: auto-resolve threshold is 2m silence for this PD rule. We should coordinate PD -> prometheus thresholds to avoid echo.
ryan: filing follow-up ticket: INF-1122 (track alert tuning + proxy timeout investigation). Assign -> eng-platform + SRE. No customer-impacting incidents for now.
priya: handoff to tim (oncall) in 15m — summarize: transient 5xx spikes, proxy conn resets, nodes rotated earlier; alert window adjusted; ticket INF-1122 created. Please monitor.
tim: ack. I'll keep an eye for another flare in next hour. If it comes back and PD escalates, I'll page platform SRE. :ok_hand:
incident-bot: PD incident PDX-4789 closed (auto-resolved). Duration: 00:01:22
ryan: thanks team. we'll reopen if anything else shows up. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
